policyCatalog.name: Scheduled-job (cron) hygiene
policyCatalog.summary: No sub-15-min pollers; event-driven or sentinel-gated; scheduler-level idle/paused/deadline short-circuit; prod host only; judge health from net._http_response.

policyCatalog.name: Log & raw-payload retention
policyCatalog.summary: Every log/append table has TTL/partition; no raw HTML/blobs in Postgres; media in Storage with size limit + orphan sweep; snapshots keep latest+changed.

policyCatalog.name: Client & Realtime fetch defaults
policyCatalog.summary: staleTime>=60s, preloadStaleTime>=30s, refetchIntervalInBackground=false, pause on hidden; one auth subscriber + keyed invalidation; minimal per-row Realtime + incremental updates; HTTP cache on SSR loaders.

policyCatalog.name: AI cost governance
policyCatalog.summary: Per-user/day token or USD ceiling + circuit breaker before provider call; ai_config.max_cost_usd non-NULL; pin catalog model IDs; bounded fan-out; idempotent generate functions.

policyCatalog.name: RLS & tenancy baseline
policyCatalog.summary: No USING(true)/tautology on operational tables; no anon UPDATE of unowned rows; rate-limit anon INSERT; revoke EXECUTE from anon on SECURITY DEFINER; no PII via broad SELECT; no dangerouslySetInnerHTML on anon input.

policyCatalog.name: Secrets & auth-surface management
policyCatalog.summary: No JWT in cron.job.command (Vault); no service-role over HTTP; delete debug/reveal fns + rotate; verify_jwt=false fns need explicit gate + rate limit; remove dead secrets.

policyCatalog.name: Write-amplification & trigger discipline
policyCatalog.summary: Cap notification/aggregate fan-out (digest/queue); batch progress updates; upsert not delete-all+reinsert.

policyCatalog.name: Cost observability & attribution
policyCatalog.summary: Per-project usage ledger written by every AI/TTS/STT call site; attribute via credits--get_credit_balance by billable_item/project; gateway 7-day log not authoritative; no NULL cost columns in UI.

policyCatalog.name: Idle-project lifecycle
policyCatalog.summary: Auto-pause scheduled/background work when no real activity > 30 days; flag idle Cloud instances for pause/consolidation; idle in app tables != not billing.
